name: Ubuntu
tagline: apt 源，安全更新与主归档同址

variants.label: 清空旧配置
variants.note: 会一并删掉 sources.list.d 下的第三方源（如 docker.list）

variants.label: 写入 deb822 源文件
variants.code:
sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources > /dev/null <<'EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: {deb}
Suites: {suite} {suite}-updates {suite}-backports
Components: main restricted universe multiverse
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg

Types: deb-src
URIs: {deb}
Suites: {suite} {suite}-updates {suite}-backports
Components: main restricted universe multiverse
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg

Types: deb
URIs: {sec}
Suites: {suite}-security
Components: main restricted universe multiverse
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg

Types: deb-src
URIs: {sec}
Suites: {suite}-security
Components: main restricted universe multiverse
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg
EOF
sudo apt update

mirrors.station: 清华大学开源软件镜像站
中国科学技术大学开源软件镜像

note: 版本下拉必须与你实际运行的发行版一致——套件代号（noble / resolute）写错会让 apt 直接报找不到该套件，用 `. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME` 查自己的代号。执行前若 /etc/apt/sources.list 里还有条目，需一并注释掉，否则新旧两个入口会同时生效。deb-src 只在需要下载源码包时才要，留着会拖慢 apt update。
